# GitHub repository metadata

Use these values in the repository's **About** panel (top-right of the repository landing page). The connected GitHub integration currently supports repository files but does not expose the repository-settings mutation needed to apply these automatically.

**Description (suggested):**

> Open-source Plex Year in Review generator. Turn playback statistics into Instagram slides or a single-page infographic with custom themes and optional donations.

**Website:** leave blank until there is a hosted demo or project landing page.

**Topics:**

`plex`, `plex-media-server`, `year-in-review`, `wrapped`, `infographic`, `instagram`, `python`, `open-source`, `self-hosted`, `data-visualization`

**Features to mention in social posts:**

- Five-image carousel, single-page infographic, or both
- Any Plex server name
- Custom JSON themes in `templates/`
- Safe, local aggregate analysis of a standalone Plex database backup
- Optional donation / thank-you closing message
- No video export, hosted service, or required Plex API token

**How to apply:** Open https://github.com/antonflor/rewind-studio, select the pencil icon in the **About** section, paste the description, add the topics, and save.
